summary: Bug verification complete for 'Create Account shows connection error'. The bug is RESOLVED. Backend auth tests (10/10 passed) and frontend UI tests (registration + login) all working correctly. The fetchWithRetry helper and cache clearing fixes applied by the main agent resolved the intermittent connection error issue.
critical_code_review_comments: fetchWithRetry helper in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js provides good resilience with 1 retry and safe response parsing
Error message 'Unable to reach the server. Please refresh and try again.' is user-friendly and appropriate for network failures
seed_data_creation: Fresh test accounts created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth registration bug is FIXED. The fetchWithRetry helper with retry logic and safe response parsing resolved intermittent connection errors. Both registration and login flows working smoothly with proper redirect to dashboard and success toasts.

verified_features.registration_api: POST /api/auth/register - creates account, returns token and company data
verified_features.auth_me_api: GET /api/auth/me - returns current user with valid token, rejects invalid/missing tokens
verified_features.registration_ui: Form validation, submission, success toast, redirect to dashboard

bug_rca.original_issue: User reported 'connection error. please try again' when creating account
bug_rca.root_cause: Intermittent network issues combined with lack of retry logic and potential stale frontend cache
bug_rca.fix_applied: Main agent added fetchWithRetry helper with 1 retry and 500ms delay, safer response parsing, cleared frontend node_modules cache, and restarted frontend
bug_rca.verification: Backend API consistently returns 200 with valid token. Frontend successfully creates accounts and redirects to dashboard without errors
